title: Packages
explain: A package is a folder of `.go` files that share a package name. Names that start with a capital letter are exported, which means other packages can use them. You import a package by its module path, like `example.com/app/mathx`.
exercise: Move a helper function into its own package folder and call it from `main`.
tip: A lowercase name is private to its package. If `mathx.double` won't compile from outside, capitalize it.
